rapport_notes: Friendly, conversational tone throughout; warm acknowledgment of customer concerns; minor audio quality issues with name/address repetition did not undermine the overall connection.
process_discipline_notes: Damage coverage mentioned twice (once in Stage 1 response to their agenda, again in Stage 2 estimate summary); no silence held after 'does that make sense' in Stage 1 or after final close question.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Let me grab the date... Just so I can kind of get everything set up properly and then give you an accurate estimate.
evidence_quotes.agenda: What are just like the top most important questions that I can just kind of answer for you off the top obviously outside of pricing cause that's important to.
evidence_quotes.agenda_response: Really. How long it will take? What?... what you guys do to make sure everything transports without being damaged.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_shallow: Customer raised damage concern; rep answered with wrapping/padding and $2,000 coverage, then asked 'did that kind of help?' and immediately pivoted to address-gathering—no follow-up like 'anything else on that' or 'what else concerns you.'
evidence_quotes.sheet1_stage1: we do wrap pad protect all furniture... have like a know where we damage coverage as well... cover-up to $2,000 for any kind of incidental.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_stage2_repeat: we do have the know where we damage coverage that's already included as well. That's, that does cover-up. To $2,000 worth of damage coverage.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: we also a few days before the move. We'd like to send emails out just introducing you to the actual movers that'll be helping you on that day... that does include our on time guarantee. So this just ensure that we're evaluating your time.
evidence_quotes.communication: we'd like to send emails out just introducing you to the actual movers that'll be helping you on that day and so they are professionally trained.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: So, I would say cost wise, I would say anywhere between $741 and we always like to give a range so $741 to 963 as the range. Now we do have a two and a half hour minimum... it'll be around $630.
evidence_quotes.estimate_personalized: I am estimating about three to four hours and that does include the drive time as well... I have a drive time move about forty minutes or so.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: you only pay for the time you use. So let's just say. If we are just closer to that two and a half to three hours, then the cost estimate, it'll be around $630.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_window: So for this particular move may update this year. I am estimating about three to four hours.
evidence_quotes.close_missing_rate_lock: No explicit mention that rate locks upon booking.
evidence_quotes.close_missing_explicit_ask: Rep offers to reserve truck and provides reply/callback options but does not ask an explicit closing question like 'Would you like our help with your move?' or 'Shall we book this for you?'

top_strength: Chauntelle opened with a strong quid pro quo framing ('let me grab a few pieces of information for you... then give you an accurate estimate'), asked the customer's agenda before diving into logistics, and built a detailed, personalized estimate anchored to typical ranges.
coaching_note: Go two layers deep on every concern raised—when the customer mentioned damage protection, follow up with 'what else worries you about the move' rather than jumping to the next question; and in Stage 2, avoid repeating the damage coverage line you already covered in Stage 1, since that counts as a violation.
